phaseAnchor: Existing LoopBalance renderStart/gameEnd stamps; independent work and stage sums each reconcile to exclusive render span.
clockCost: 2 Count reads for each change of stage/work tag; equal nested tags use zero extra clocks. Wait/pacing clocks shared with existing sampler. Counter writes remain active observer work.
pacingExclusion: Begin before actual flip at original t0, end at original t1; nested instrumented functions cannot backdate accounting.
stageLabels: 20 explicit bins, including root gaps and scene preparation. Labels locate execution; interleaved submissions may be charged to later stages.
workLabels: 11 explicit bins including render-other, Core prep, bounds, dispatch, geometry copies, EE clipping, texture, object state, packet build, submission and cache flush.
counterLimits: Input/event counts only. Texture-chain QWs omit REF payload and submit-source QWs are not bus bytes. Effect stage calls include inactive gate checks.
legacyRenderCostCapture: Rejected when armed in measured raw loops; ordinary render-cost request remains zero. No per-object fairness drains enabled.
